text:
alexa: FYI new GPU nodes in eu-central are failing kubelet boot because KMS decrypt is returning 403 after this morning's firewall tighten. allocator join rate down ~12%.
rio: seeing same. keystore-proxy logs: POST /v1/decrypt 403 {"error":"missing-keystore-exception-tag"}. tl;dr: subnet tag not pushed to two AZs during rollout.
omar: that audit-egress PR tightened egress to only privatelink collectors, correct? any manual exceptions?
alexa: yes, exceptions exist but tag auto-propagation missed gpu-subnet-eu. looks like our tag reconcile job failed at 03:01.
patch-bot: alert: tag-reconcile failed for project infra-eu at 03:01 UTC. retry scheduled.
rio: quick mitigation options: 1) add temporary exception for keystore endpoints via firewall (fast but increases NAT/privatelink egress) 2) rollback the deny rule for gpu subnets in affected AZs (safer perf-wise).
omar: cost readout: temporary exception -> estimated +$900/day if sustained; rollback -> config churn but negligible immediate cost.
alexa: prefer rollback on small blast radius: eu-central-1a first, 10m watch, then 1b. keep canary weight low.
infra-bot: scheduled rollback job ci-run/rollback-subnet-eu-175800 at 06:14 UTC pending approval.
rio: I'll prepare the rollback commands and an affinity tweak to reduce new node churn to warmed nodes during rollout.
omar: also ensure keystore has an exponential retry backlog drain plan; we saw retries spike in last incident and it clogged the token issuer.
alexa: rolling in eu-central-1a now. will post status when done. :crossed_fingers:
(3m) patch-bot: rollback applied to gpu-subnet-eu-central-1a by alexa at 06:17 UTC.
alexa: allocator success improved from 86% -> 97% within 4m. joining stabilized.
rio: creating ticket INF-7621 for root cause (tag reconcile failures), assignments neteng + infra-ci. action items: fix reconcile idempotency, add post-rollout subnet-tag verification CI gate, run tagging chaos test.
omar: will draft mitigation SOP and cost note for finance: include estimate for temporary allowlist and actual rollback impact.
alexa: thanks all. will follow up with short incident note in #infra and close after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
